ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is both predator and prey?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the picture is a food web, containing organisms or substances such as Duck, Mongoose, Lizard, Plants, Fish, Algae, Ants, Cockroach, Earthworm, and Decomposing stuff. Blue arrows connect different nodes; it can be seen that there is an arrow from Mongoose pointing to Lizard, indicating that Lizard is preyed on by Mongoose; at the same time, it can also be seen that Lizard connects to and points to smaller organisms, such as Earthworm and others, indicating that Lizard preys on them. Then reason: an organism that is both a predator and prey needs both to prey on other organisms and to be preyed on by other organisms. Lizard preys on smaller organisms and is also preyed on by Mongoose, so it is both a predator and prey.
